Translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O the One who always bestows favor upon creation
O the One who extends His hands with gifts
O the Master of sublime grants
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
The best of creation in character
And forgive us, O the Most High
